name: decode_android_resources
description: Decode one local APK's resources with `apktool d --no-src` in a provider-owned workspace that is removed after projection: the readable AndroidManifest.xml, apktool.yml version and SDK facts, the app's string resources (default or selected locales, bounded to 2000 entries per table), selectable string locales, and the decoded file count. The target APK is digest with SHA-256 before decoding; smali is skipped because Java-source recovery belongs to the JADX family.

locale.description: Project strings from res/values-<locale>/strings.xml instead of the default table

locales.description: Project multiple localized string tables from res/values-<locale>/strings.xml alongside the default table (bounded to 20 locales)

string_tables_only.description: Return selected strings only in string_tables, leaving top-level strings empty. Omit to preserve the primary strings field.
